name: Detección de Remuestreo
description: Detecta interpolation artefactos from image scaling, rotation, or skewing operations.
algorithm: Periodic Correlation Detection in Resampled Signals
mechanism: Analiza periodic correlacións introduced by resampling operations. When an image is scaled or rotated, interpolation creates detectable periodic patrones in pixel derivatives that can be revealed through análisis espectral.
parameters: Analysis: EM algorithm, Radon transform projection, Derivative filter: [-1, 1], Spectrum: 64-point DFT
source: Popescu, A.C. & Farid, H. (2005) — Exposing Digital Forgeries by Detecting Traces of Resampling, IEEE TSP
useCase: Detecting geometric transformations applied during image empalme or composition

references.title: Popescu, A.C. & Farid, H. (2005) — Exposing Digital Forgeries by Detecting Traces of Resampling, IEEE TSP

strengths:
• Altamente preciso para detectar escalado/rotación
• Teóricamente bien fundamentado
• Puede estimar el factor de remuestreo
• Funciona con diferentes métodos de interpolación
limitations:
• Requires large homogeneous regions
• May fail on heavily textured areas
• Computacionalmente intensivo EM fitting
• compresión JPEG can mask traces
